GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (28 Nov 45) CCS
(SCAPIN - 363)
28 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Radio Telegraph service between Tokyo and Bandoeing and Boekittinggi, N.E.I.
1. The Imperial Japanese Government is directed to terminate operation of the radio telegraph service between Tokyo and Bandoeing and Boekittinggi, N. E. I., effective immediately.
2. Acknowledgement of receipt of this memorandum is designated.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
